rules.description: Expire untagged images after 3 days. Each deploy pushes :latest, which orphans the previous image; nothing references it afterwards. Matches the 3-day rollback window used for trades.db versions in S3.

Keep the 10 most recent images overall. A deploy adds two (the :latest push and the SAM-tagged push), so this retains roughly the last five deploys for rollback. Older images are rebuildable from git.
